dockerfile:
FROM python:3.9-slim
RUN apt-get update && apt-get install -y \
    build-essential \
    libbcc-dev \
    && rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
WORKDIR /app
COPY requirements.txt .
RUN pip install --no-cache-dir -r requirements.txt
COPY . .
CMD ["python", "your_script.py"]
explanation: Generated a minimal requirements.txt with only the detected 'bcc' import. The Dockerfile uses python:3.9-slim and installs system dependencies required for bcc (BPF Compiler Collection) including build-essential and libbcc-dev. The final CMD assumes a main script named 'your_script.py' which should be adjusted based on actual project structure.
